source_scope: Execute exact ConfigurableTask doc_to_text, doc_to_choice, doc_to_target and construct_requests methods plus native Instance under an explicit AST dependency scaffold. Native Jinja apply_template and task YAML/defaults are captured. No full harness dataset loader, fewshot driver, tokenizer, model, likelihood scoring or metric execution is claimed.
source_split: Previously captured official test splits; prior One-Eval source observations are known. New evaluator methods and their request outputs have not yet been applied to this sample.
selection: Per source split, sort full captured source rows by SHA256 of 'harness-transfer-v1|' plus canonical UTF8 JSON(sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False,separators comma/colon); tie by source row index. Select first100, retain acquisition/schema exceptions without replacement.
oracle: Independent lookup answerKey in choices.label gives gold index and choices.text gives the complete ordered alternative set. Compare native target index, choice order and complete per-option context/continuation requests. Native likelihood options occur in continuations, not necessarily in the common context.

conditions.native: Use doc_to_text as zero-shot context and exact construct_requests
conditions.benign_context_spacing: Append two newlines to the context before exact request construction; source question/options preserved
conditions.drop_continuation: Drop first non-gold request but retain original adapter record
conditions.replace_continuation: Replace first non-gold request continuation with a unique nonce but retain original adapter record
conditions.omit_question_context: Replace every actual request context by a nonce while retaining original adapter record

wire_guard: Check actual request count, ordered continuation strings with native target delimiter, expected context equality and full source question containment. Detect stale choice/prompt metadata at the request boundary. Local counting backend only.
v2_scope: Apply byte-frozen v2 to adapter record, separately report raw wire checks. The600 wire counterexamples intentionally test stale adapter metadata outside v2 trust assumptions; do not describe them as native engine bugs.
changes_after_outcomes: Do not modify frozen checker or source methods to change observed outcomes. Report limitations and failures as found.
interpretation: Cross-evaluator transfer on reused known source records with an independently specified request oracle; not blind unseen-data generalization, new prevalence evidence, full engine execution, or external impact.
